propositions: Enable Jira Cloud rich-text reconciliation by setting reconciler.rich_text_cutover to 'cloud' in project rebar.toml configuration.
Legacy golden-equivalence test inherits project operational config and must explicitly set REBAR_RECONCILER_RICH_TEXT_CUTOVER=off in backend fixture to preserve pre-cutover plain-wire expectations.
Test fails under project cloud config because ADF codec emits Markdown description with newline whereas golden expects plain-wire form without newline.
Backend fixture must change from module scope to function scope and accept monkeypatch to inject environment override before JiraBackend construction.
Verify rebar config command reports reconciler.rich_text_cutover as 'cloud [project]' and passes validation, lint, typecheck, and CI test matrix.
